label: cliffspike hit
brief: One creature on a neutral stage beside a 1.80 m human ruler: standing, then the hit react at three moments (the blow landing, held, recovering). Judge the creature's model and material as the game's real look - identity, silhouette, appeal, surface and colour, proportion and scale against the ruler - and whether the hit reads as a grounded flinch from a blow.
defects: Hit react rears up or leaps clear of the stage: a pounce, not a flinch
